decisions.quote: Thus, this replication of the claim was partially failed according to the SCORE criteria, while the overall ANOVA and the ANOVA on English mappings did not show the effect, the ANOVA on Hebrew mappings replicated the reported effect.
decisions.reason: In the final combined-sample (Stage 2) results, the author explicitly characterizes the overall replication outcome as partially failed because the overall three-way interaction and English mapping effect did not replicate whereas the Hebrew mapping effect replicated the original finding, which maps to 'mixed' under the codebook.
